diffs.diff: pin count: part has 7 (Vin GND 3Vo INT LED SCL SDA), datasheet reading has 6 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA INT)
diffs.evidence: Adafruit SI1145 breakout (#1777) pinouts page lists 7 pins: Power Pins 'Vin', 'GND', '3vo'; Extra Pins 'INT - this it the interrupt output from the chip, with a 10K pullup to 3.3V' and 'LED - if you'd like to try using the proximity capabilities of the SI1145, you can tie an IR LED to this pin ... It's a open collector pin, so connect the cathode (-) pin to this pin'; I2C Pins 'SCL', 'SDA'. The second reading left out the LED pin; it was not a different board variant. The model's 7 pins (Vin GND 3Vo INT LED SCL SDA) match the vendor pinout.
